title: FALCON: A CROSS-MODAL EVALUATION DATASET FOR COMPREHENSIVE SAFETY PERCEPTION
findings: The paper's benchmark includes 'Hate Speech' as a harm category, which is defined as content expressing hatred against groups based on characteristics including religion. However, the paper does not report specific findings for religious content distinctly. In the general 'Hate Speech' category, the proposed model FalconEye achieved a detection accuracy of 44.85% on the Falcon-test dataset, outperforming GPT-40 (33.33%) and Qwen2.5-VL-7B (25.45%).
